out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Strong suction from the top of the head “like a vacuum”; no longer needed to breathe; felt “encased… as if mummified.”

tunnel.passage_other_detail: “moving through some kind of a portal” with many others; “travelled very quickly.”

arrival.other_being_detail: A Latino “teacher or Guide” (deceased truck driver) teaching humility; later a very loving luminous Guide with “so much light coming from his face”; “Elders”/helpers mentioned.

environment.environment_other_detail: “waiting room situation,” later a “bigger and brighter room… like a high school cafeteria.”

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Guided return: told to “Point your finger forward. Touch the planet,” then a pulling sensation; later struggled to re-enter body until husband touched/shook her; felt a “POP” back into body.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Implied purpose: return to care for daughter/family; “return to the Earth”; later interprets lesson as letting go of victimhood/self-absorption and learning humility; sharing experience to help others in pain.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Medication reaction/overdose-like event causing inability to breathe (airway swelling) after taking three prescribed pills.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: “the religion I grew up in” (Christian; denomination not specified).
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Fervent belief in God; prayer; Jesus as example.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Cosmic/astronomical “download” with holographic words/numbers; “Novata… Prepare for the Seventh Day”; warnings about altered/poisoned food; travel over Earth; hair changing at will; attempted grabbing by teenage boys; daughter appears in spirit via “school bus.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/separation → portal/waiting-room realms with many deceased → guide/teacher encounter → later luminous Guide and cosmic knowledge/earth scenes → life review (order uncertain; experiencer says possibly simultaneous) → return negotiation using daughter and future image of mother → re-entry struggle into body.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Experiencer explicitly notes events may have occurred “before, after, or simultaneously… tempted to say it was ‘all at once.’”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: “Waiting room”/cafeteria-like afterlife social scene; teacher explaining many there had effectively “aborted their own lives” (broad definition of suicide); attempted physical/sexual-energy grabbing by deceased teens; cosmic “math/science” download with holographic numbers; word “Novata” and phrase “Prepare for the Seventh Day” with piano/octaves imagery; guidance for re-entry via repeatedly pushing through throat to make a groan so husband would touch her; post-return temporary ability to see light/vibrations and “into the realm around ours.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “There was a strong suction coming from the top of my head (like a vacuum) and an absolute sense of relief.”; “They are deceased. They have died.”; “You are in between. You are as if in a coma.”; “You are written in the stars.”; “Prepare for the Seventh Day.”; “But Mommy? Who will take care of us?”; “Point your finger forward. Touch the planet.”; “You must push yourself again and again through the throat area… You must get him to touch you in order to connect.”
